title: 2013 Toyota Highlander Passenger-Side Collision Repair
summary: Collision repair on a 2013 Toyota Highlander with passenger-side front damage at Carcis Autobody Repair.
story: A 2013 Toyota Highlander arrived with severe impact damage to the front passenger side. The collision crushed the right front fender, shattered the headlight assembly, tore open the inner wheel liner, and damaged the front bumper cover.

Technicians disassembled the front end to inspect the underlying apron structure and mounting points. The repair required replacing the passenger-side fender, headlight assembly, inner fender liner, and bumper components. Structural alignments were checked to ensure proper panel fitment and gap tolerances across the hood and front door.

After structural and body repairs, the replacement panels were prepped, primed, and painted to match the factory maroon color. Clear coat was applied and blended across adjoining panels for a seamless finish. Final reassembly included aligning the new headlight assembly and verifying all front clip components were secure.
